notizie.titolo: Like fridges, heat pumps don’t need an annual service | Letter
notizie.riassunto: Ground-source and air-source heat pumps are extremely efficient machines, writes, David Reynolds I read Mary Massey’s letter ( 2 November ) with some surprise. She said that her heat pump needs an annual service and that this year it cost about £350. My ground-source heat pump has been heating my house for 18 years and it does not need or get an annual service.

notizie.titolo: UK households face rush to find green energy installer to beat April VAT hike
